findings.title: Customer Concentration Risk
findings.description: Top three customers represent approximately 48% of total revenue, with the largest single customer accounting for 22%.
findings.mitigation: Requesting multi-year contract extensions and evaluating a customer diversification plan with management prior to IC submission.

findings.title: Environmental Liabilities
findings.description: Legacy chemical handling and coating operations at the Ohio facility may carry unassessed environmental remediation exposure.
findings.mitigation: Engaging a Phase II environmental site assessment; closing will be conditioned on satisfactory findings.

findings.title: Regulatory Exposure
findings.description: Recent CMS reimbursement rate changes for molecular diagnostics testing could compress margins on roughly 30% of test volume.
findings.mitigation: Modeling downside reimbursement scenarios and stress-testing covenant headroom; sponsor has agreed to an equity cure provision.

findings.title: Key Personnel Dependency
findings.description: Founder-CEO holds significant institutional relationships and lab accreditation oversight with no identified successor.
findings.mitigation: Negotiating key-person insurance and a 24-month employment and non-compete agreement as a closing condition.

findings.title: Acquisition Integration Risk
findings.description: Three tuck-in lab acquisitions completed in the past 18 months have not yet been fully integrated onto a common billing and LIS platform.
findings.mitigation: Commercial diligence team is validating the integration roadmap and synergy assumptions with a third-party consultant.

findings.title: Cybersecurity & Data Privacy Exposure
findings.description: A prior penetration test identified unresolved vulnerabilities in the customer-facing API layer that handles sensitive supply chain data.
findings.mitigation: Requiring remediation plan completion and an independent re-test prior to closing, backstopped by a cyber insurance covenant.

findings.title: Customer Concentration Risk
findings.description: Top five customers represent 34% of annual recurring revenue, with average contract tenure of just 2.1 years.
findings.mitigation: Reviewing net revenue retention trends and renewal pipeline; building a concentration covenant into the credit agreement.

findings.title: Revenue Recognition Practices
findings.description: Company recognizes a portion of implementation fees upfront rather than over the service period, inflating near-term reported revenue.
findings.mitigation: QoE provider adjusted normalized EBITDA for the recognition policy; sponsor has agreed to restate historicals.

findings.title: Same-Store Sales Deceleration
findings.description: Same-store sales growth decelerated from 6.2% to 1.1% over the trailing four quarters amid a discretionary spending pullback.
findings.mitigation: Incorporated conservative base-case sales assumptions into the credit model; structured a springing cash-flow sweep tied to performance triggers.

findings.title: Lease Renewal & Occupancy Cost Risk
findings.description: 18% of store leases (by revenue) expire within the next 24 months, exposing the company to rent escalation risk.
findings.mitigation: Commercial team reviewed landlord relationships and renewal terms; no material closures are anticipated.

findings.title: E-commerce Channel Underinvestment
findings.description: Digital channel represents only 9% of sales, below the 15-20% typical for specialty retail peers.
findings.mitigation: Sponsor has committed to a post-close capex plan for digital platform investment, tracked via a use-of-proceeds covenant.

findings.title: Supply Chain & Tariff Exposure
findings.description: Approximately 40% of sourced goods originate from tariff-exposed regions, creating potential cost inflation risk.
findings.mitigation: Management is diversifying sourcing to Vietnam and Mexico; progress is monitored via a quarterly reporting covenant.

findings.title: Commodity Price Sensitivity
findings.description: Approximately 25% of gathering and processing margin remains directly exposed to natural gas and NGL price movements.
findings.mitigation: Sponsor has layered on additional hedges covering 70% of forecasted volumes through 2028.

findings.title: Regulatory & Environmental Permitting Risk
findings.description: Pending state-level methane emissions rules could require capital investment in leak detection and monitoring equipment.
findings.mitigation: Technical diligence estimates compliance capex at under $4m; included in the base-case financial model.

findings.title: Counterparty Concentration in Offtake Agreements
findings.description: Two counterparties represent 55% of contracted gathering volumes under long-term agreements.
findings.mitigation: Both counterparties are investment-grade rated; legal team confirmed no cross-default provisions with the borrower.

findings.title: Tenant Concentration in Anchor Leases
findings.description: Top two tenants represent 41% of portfolio rental income under leases with staggered expirations through 2033.
findings.mitigation: Structured a minimum occupancy covenant and lease assignment as collateral to protect against tenant loss.

findings.title: Interest Rate Refinancing Risk
findings.description: Floating-rate loan structure exposed the borrower to rate volatility ahead of a 2031 refinancing wall.
findings.mitigation: Borrower executed an interest rate cap covering 100% of the loan balance for the first five years, required at closing.

findings.title: Property Condition & Deferred Maintenance
findings.description: Engineering report identified approximately $2.1m of deferred roof and HVAC maintenance across the portfolio.
findings.mitigation: Established a lender-controlled capex reserve account funded at closing to cover identified deferred maintenance.
